_doc: Seat p = the rider's HIPS when sitting (Chibi sit: hips 0.41 above the feet, hands +0.20 up / +0.34 forward; ride: hips 0.60, hands +0.13 / +0.32), or the FEET when stand: true. Every vehicle's numbers. Frame: +z forward, +y up, +x = the LEFT side. Units: metres, kg, newtons. Wheel p = hub position with the suspension fully extended. Seats: p = where the rider's hips go; pose = Chibi clip ('sit', 'ride', 'idle'); exit = where you step out (vehicle frame). Built for Chibi 2.5 riders: 1.73 m tall, hips 0.60, arms 0.41, head top = seat + 1.13.

vehicles.name: Trail Jeep
vehicles.blurb: Rugged open jeep. Driver, a gunner on the turret and a passenger.

parts._doc: rear deck the gunner stands on

vehicles.name: Dirtbike
vehicles.blurb: Light, quick and jumpy. Lean into turns; hold Shift to lean back for a wheelie.

parts._doc: the high wing: raised from 1.15 to 1.45 so the cabin roof under it clears seated Chibi heads (seat + 1.13)

vehicles.name: Box Trailer
vehicles.blurb: A big box on wheels. Open the back (F) to walk or drive up the ramp; whatever you load stays put.

vehicles.name: Flatbed Trailer
vehicles.blurb: A flat deck with low rails: strap a vehicle or crates on top.

vehicles.name: Tanker Trailer
vehicles.blurb: A round tank of water. Heavy; it sways in the bends.

vehicles.name: Brightwater Fire Truck
vehicles.blurb: Siren for the driver; the one on the back aims a water cannon that shoves things around.

vehicles.name: Swiftcare Ambulance
vehicles.blurb: Siren and lights for the driver; open the back (F) to load a stretcher or crates.

vehicles.name: Patrol Car
vehicles.blurb: Fast and grippy, with siren and lights. Lift the trunk (F) to load it.

vehicles.name: Meadowlark Sedan
vehicles.blurb: A friendly four-door family car. Safe in a crash, and the trunk (F to lift it) holds a crate and a bag.

chassis._doc: floor pan: shorter than the body and 0.25 m off the ground so the overhangs clear rolling bumps; its top (y 0.22) is the cabin and trunk floor

parts._doc: cabin: roof top 1.59 so the drawn roof (underside 1.52) clears seated heads (seat + 1.13 = 1.49)
bonnet + front bumper (underside 0.65 m off the ground)
trunk floor past the floor pan, + rear bumper
trunk side walls (0.12 m thick so CCD props cannot slip through)
trunk back wall; the floor is the chassis top (y 0.22)
trunk lid: inside is x +-0.74, y 0.22..0.78, z -2.08..-1.22 (fits a crate + a bag)

vehicles.name: Scramble Quad
vehicles.blurb: A nippy four-wheeler with fat tyres. One rider and a pillion; hit something hard and you both go flying.

vehicles.name: Sandhopper Buggy
vehicles.blurb: Light, open roll cage and huge springs: it soaks up landings that would throw you out of anything else.

chassis._doc: rides 0.57 m off the ground: more than the springs can squash, so a big landing never hits the belly

parts._doc: roll cage roof: it lands on this, not on heads (seated head 1.43)

vehicles.name: Roadrunner Motorcycle
vehicles.blurb: A road bike: lower and faster than the dirtbike, stiff springs. Lean into the bends; it hates rough ground.

vehicles.name: Pedalpush Bicycle
vehicles.blurb: Tap the gas to pedal hard (holding it just cruises). Slow, quiet, and easy to fall off.

chassis._doc: tall thin box: frame + where the (massless) rider sits; the height gives it enough roll inertia to balance smoothly at 60 Hz

pedal._doc: each fresh press of gas adds `tap` to a burst that fades at `decay`/s; holding gas only cruises at `cruise`

vehicles.name: Trailhauler Six
vehicles.blurb: Six-wheel cargo truck. Ten ride: two in the cab, eight on the benches, one standing — or just stand in the open bed. F drops the tailgate as a ramp.

chassis._doc: the chassis top IS the cargo-bed floor (y 0.45): people stand on it and ride it like any vehicle platform

parts._doc: side rails, waist-high to a standing rider
tailgate; open, it is a ramp down to the ground behind the truck

seats._doc: standing behind the cab, holding the front rail

vehicles.name: Goldline Harvester
vehicles.blurb: Drive it through the wheat to cut it. Slow and wide; mind the header.

vehicles.name: crate
vehicles.blurb: A wooden crate. Pick it up with E; it fits in a trunk.

vehicles.name: bag
vehicles.blurb: A canvas kit bag.

vehicles.name: barrel
vehicles.blurb: A fuel barrel. Heavy.

vehicles.name: big ball
vehicles.blurb: A huge bouncy ball. Push it around with a car.

vehicles.name: Jetpack
vehicles.blurb: Strap it on (E), then hold jump in the air to fly.
